scenario_name: Verify successful end-to-end product flow from search to bag removal
Verify fallback size selection when size 40 is unavailable
Verify search results for invalid or non-existent product keywords
Verify system behavior when adding an item to the bag without selecting a size
Validate consistency of product price between PDP and Shopping Bag
Validate that bag item count updates accurately upon adding and removing items
Verify application behavior with extreme search query lengths
Verify navigation and interaction during high-latency network conditions
Verify that no sensitive user data is exposed in URL parameters or browser console
Verify that the bag contents are not accessible by unauthorized sessions (CORS/Session check)
Verify user-friendly messaging when the bag is empty
Verify responsive behavior of the Add to Bag button and removal confirmation dialog
